create_PushWorldEnv: create a PushWorldEnv instance with a puzzle file path argument
run_demo_gym_env: run the demo gym environment script with a puzzle file path via CLI
reset_environment: reset the PushWorldEnv and retrieve the initial observation image and info
step_environment: step the PushWorldEnv with a random action index and retrieve the next observation
visualize_observation: visualize the PushWorldEnv observation image using matplotlib pyplot
